notes.title: Data Thief Goes Free To Play
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Due to unforseen circumstances, Ottercopter is no longer able to work on Data Thief in full capacity. As we do not feel comfortable charging players for a game that contains some outstanding issues, we have decided to release our game, as is, free of charge. As our developers gain additional capacity, they may return to patch bugs and implement additional levels.

We thank you for all your patience and support,
Ottercopter Studios, LLC
